snippet.title: 'Flow - Syn x Vertue' - Preview Trailer (1984)
snippet.description:
Twitter: https://twitter.com/FlowSynVertue
Game: https://pavillionhub.com/goto/flow
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2658830/Flow__Syn_x_Vertue/

Music by 'Sight Telma Club'
https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCViQmohoalSgV5RRUZTGl_Q
https://twitter.com/SightTelmaClub

Beat saber, meets WipEout, meets Mashed.

'Flow - Syn x Vertue' is more than the sum of it's parts. Weaving Synthwave, Darkwave and Art Pop music genres into it's three distinct, and distinctly different, game styles.

- Flow [Endless Chill] - Classic arcade gameplay and music-centric flow and zone modes, perfect for single player.
- Syn [Drive to survive] - Elimination with a ghostly twist, and Capture the Streaker royale modes.
- Vertue [Roadtrip] - Co-Op game modes utilizing creative game design and accessible peripheral design to create a collection of experiences that are perfect for collaborative party play.

Endless Chill:
Music interaction comes to the fore as players zone out, and then zone in, as they discover their music induced zen in the 'Flow' game modes. These are single player experiences with a focus on classic arcade time extension modes and modern endless runner CGC twists, with asynchronous PvP challenge modes.

Social Play:
Our 'Syn' and 'Vertue' collections are built as contrasting dark vs light online and local multiplayer game modes. From the tense and frenetic 'Delimination Royale’ mode to the co-op collaborative 'Red & Blue' mode, our social game modes are built for both lol and sol (scream out loud).

User Generated Content:
From track creation, through vehicle customization, race modification, and music production - Building creative and empowering content creation tools is at the heart of everything we do.
‘Flow - Syn x Vertue' has been built using the UGC tools that we built.
(Is that Meta or what!?).

OST + Licensed + AI Music: 
Using in-built music tools, musicians and players can integrate their own custom tracks, either scratch built, ethically generated AI based on our OST, or with AI trained on opt-in artist uploaded tracks - Featuring automated license attribution and artist royalties.
Allowing players to easily and quickly create the perfect mood to suit their custom gameplay.
